_original_lore: The Minos Champion is one of the rare mobs
in the Mythological Ritual, and can only be
found by using a epic or legendary Griffin Pet.
It gains roughly 3 to 4% of a damage buff for each second
it's lived for, capping at 600%, which is when it despawns.
While alive, it can attack using a sword or a bow, if
the Champion is unable to reach a player, it will spawn
a lighting strike on the player once, similary
name: 弥诺斯勇士 (神话生物)

source: The Minos Champion is one of the rare mobs
